channel.title: Read Mandarin
channel.description: Learn Mandarin Chinese with free HSK-graded short readings. Every text comes with pinyin, tap-to-translate words, audio and English translation.

item.title: 《三体》现象 — The Three-Body Problem Phenomenon (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 202 words. 二零一五年，刘慈欣凭借《三体》摘得雨果奖，这是亚洲作家首次获得这一世界级科幻大奖。 — The Three-Body Problem Phenomenon. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 量子计算浅谈 — A Brief Look at Quantum Computing (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 200 words. 提起量子计算，很多人的第一反应是“速度更快的电脑”，但这种理解其实并不准确。 — A Brief Look at Quantum Computing. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 国潮兴起 — The Rise of Guochao (China-Chic) (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 204 words. 十年前，提到“中国风”设计，人们脑海中浮现的往往是大红灯笼与生硬的龙纹图案，透着一股过时的匠气。 — The Rise of Guochao (China-Chic). Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 数字货币 — Digital Currency and the Question of Trust (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 204 words. 传统货币的信任建立在国家信用之上，人们相信央行不会随意印钞，银行不会卷款跑路。 — Digital Currency and the Question of Trust. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 考古新发现 — A New Archaeological Discovery (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 193 words. 考古学最迷人之处，在于它常常在不经意间颠覆我们对过去的固有认知。 — A New Archaeological Discovery. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 睡眠经济 — The Sleep Economy (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 164 words. 上个月我总是失眠，朋友建议我试试“助眠”产品。 — The Sleep Economy. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 友情的保质期 — The Shelf Life of Friendship (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 164 words. 上周，我在朋友圈看到大学同学小林结婚的消息，立刻给她发了信息。 — The Shelf Life of Friendship. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 隐私与便利 — Privacy and Convenience (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 166 words. 现在很多商店都可以用刷脸支付，几秒钟就能完成付款。 — Privacy and Convenience. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 网络暴力 — Online Harassment (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 161 words. 上个月我的朋友小雨在网上发了一张自拍照，没想到收到了很多难听的评论。 — Online Harassment. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 第一次创业 — My First Startup (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 163 words. 三年前，我用自己存的两万块钱，开了一家小小的奶茶店。 — My First Startup. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 雾霾与蓝天 — Smog and Blue Sky (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 130 words. 五年前，中国很多城市的天很少是蓝色的，到处都是雾霾。 — Smog and Blue Sky. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 流行音乐 — Pop Music (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 144 words. 打开手机里的音乐软件，到处都是好听的流行歌曲。 — Pop Music. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 功夫电影 — Kung Fu Movies (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 144 words. 说起中国电影，很多外国人第一个想到的就是功夫电影。 — Kung Fu Movies. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 请坐，请喝茶 — Please Sit, Please Have Tea (HSK 1)
item.description: HSK 1 · 40 words. 朋友来我家，我很高兴。 — Please Sit, Please Have Tea. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 再见，老师 — Goodbye, Teacher (HSK 1)
item.description: HSK 1 · 32 words. 我在学校学习汉语。 — Goodbye, Teacher. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 小狗和小猫 — Dog and Cat (HSK 1)
item.description: HSK 1 · 46 words. 我家有一个小狗，也有一个小猫。 — Dog and Cat. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 大商店小商店 — Big Shop, Small Shop (HSK 1)
item.description: HSK 1 · 51 words. 这个商店很大，那个商店很小。 — Big Shop, Small Shop. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 苹果和米饭 — Apples and Rice (HSK 1)
item.description: HSK 1 · 41 words. 我喜欢苹果，也喜欢米饭。 — Apples and Rice. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 科技伦理 — Tech Ethics (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 149 words. 科学技术的迅猛发展，正以前所未有的速度改变着人类的生活。 — Tech Ethics. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 坚持的力量 — The Power of Persistence (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 65 words. 古人说：“滴水穿石。” — The Power of Persistence. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 媒介素养 — Media Literacy (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 132 words. 在信息爆炸的时代，人人都是信息的接收者，同时也是传播者。 — Media Literacy. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 全球化的退潮 — The Ebb of Globalization (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 125 words. 过去几十年，全球化曾被视为不可逆转的历史潮流。 — The Ebb of Globalization. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 集体与个人 — Collective and Individual (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 142 words. 在中国传统文化中，集体利益往往被置于个人利益之上。 — Collective and Individual. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 大城市病 — Big City Disease (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 144 words. 高楼林立、车水马龙，大城市以其繁华吸引着无数追梦的年轻人。 — Big City Disease. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 城市化 — Urbanization (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 150 words. 最近几十年，越来越多的农村人离开家乡，到大城市去工作和生活。 — Urbanization. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 留学的得与失 — The Gains and Losses of Studying Abroad (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 154 words. 如今，出国留学已经不是什么新鲜事，每年都有几十万学生去国外读书。 — The Gains and Losses of Studying Abroad. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 网上购物 — Online Shopping (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 59 words. 随着网络的发展，网上购物变得越来越普遍。 — Online Shopping. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 代沟 — The Generation Gap (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 153 words. “代沟”指的是两代人之间在想法和生活方式上的差别。 — The Generation Gap. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 文化冲击 — Culture Shock (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 169 words. 很多人到了国外，都会经历一段不适应的时期，这就是所谓的“文化冲击”。 — Culture Shock. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 老龄化社会 — The Aging Society (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 142 words. 随着医学的发展，人们的寿命越来越长，社会上的老年人也越来越多。 — The Aging Society. Pinyin, audio and English included.
